messages:
Priya (eng-ml): Intake: ACME Corp asking for a customer-specific INSTRUCT variant of rwd-llama-2 with 32k context. Requirements: int8 quant, preserve instruction-following quality >= baseline, latency target p95 < 600ms for 2-token streaming, and support prefix caching for multi-turn flows. Ticket: https://rwd/jira/ACME-412 (created).

Leah (cs): Noted. Customer expects initial demo in 2 weeks, but can trade time for fidelity. Priority = high if legal signoff lands this week.

Ethan (eng-sre): Do we have spare node capacity in us-west-2 with 80GB GPUs for 32k KV? If we plan int8 + 32k, memory for KV cache could be tight. Can we consider chunked key-value sharding?

Marco (ml-research): Quick notes from past experiments: int8 (GPT-style OoT) on rwd-llama-2-lite had ~3% drop on instruction eval suite (instr-eval-v3) at 8k. With per-layer calibration + outlier-aware rounding we reduced to ~1.2%. For 32k, attention chunking and windowed KV caching used in prior longctx builds. I can run a small sweep: 4 seeds, per-layer calib, and compare perplexity + instr-eval.

Priya (eng-ml): Proposed bring-up checklist (short):
- Acquire customer prompts / eval set (Leah)
- Create variant branch + model config (Marco)
- Unit perf tests: 2-token p95, cold-start latency, mem footprint (Ethan)
- Quality eval: instr-eval-v3, rouge/bleu for domain prompts, regression delta <= 1.5% (Marco)
- Quant sweep: int8 static, int8 per-layer calib, int4 if requested (Marco)
- Canary deploy with traffic shaping + fallback to base model (Ethan)
- Docs + security review (Leah)

Priya (eng-ml): Quick config snippet for the variant (for infra):
```
model: rwd-llama-2-acme-instruct
base: rwd-llama-2-13B
context_window: 32768
quantization: int8_per_layer_calibration
batching: auto
cache_policy: prefix_kv_windowed
metrics: instr-eval-v3, latency-p95, mem-usage
```

Ethan (eng-sre): Looks good. For canary, I suggest: 5% traffic, 1M tokens/day cap, and an automatic rollback trigger: instr-eval regression > 2% or p95 > 650ms for 10m window. Also need a warm-up job for KV populating before demo.

Leah (cs): I'll ask ACME for a 200-example eval set focused on instruction style + 50 failure cases they care about. Also check if they need data residency (likely).

Marco (ml-research): I'll queue the quant sweep today. Plan: run on 2 GPUs (dev cluster), measure instr-eval-v3 pass rate, and collect calibration stats. I'll tag results in the ticket. Expected turnaround ~48-72h for initial sweep.

Priya (eng-ml): Owner assignments: Marco -> model config & quant sweep; Ethan -> perf & canary infra; Leah -> customer eval + compliance; Priya -> rollout plan + final signoff.

oncall-bot: Jira ticket ACME-412 created by Priya. Epic: customer-variants-2026.

Ethan (eng-sre): One more infra note: with 32k we should enable streaming chunking for clients with >8k input to keep latency predictable. Will add a runtime flag `stream_chunk_size` default 2048.

Leah (cs): Customer follow-up: they want to test a few instruction styles (legal, transactional, faq rewriting). I'll send those in a single CSV to the ticket.

Marco (ml-research): If int8 per-layer hits the quality target, we'll document the calibration recipe in the repo: `quant/recipes/acme_int8_calib.md`. If not, next step is blockwise q-attn or selective fp16 for some layers.

Priya (eng-ml): Timeline sync: Marco starts today -> initial qual + perf in 72h, Ethan prepares canary infra in parallel -> smoke deploy by day 5, demo day 10-14 depending on CS readiness.

Leah (cs): ack. I'll schedule touchpoints: daily standup for week 1.

Ethan (eng-sre): I'll also attach a small benchmark snippet for reproducing p95 locally: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://infer.rwd/api/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-llama-2-acme-instruct","prompt":"<long-demo>","max_tokens":2}'
```

Priya (eng-ml): Great. If anyone spots a blocker (licensing, KMS, or perf), mention it here and I'll escalate. Otherwise I'll update ACME-412 with the checklist and start the rollout doc. :rocket:
